en.t: First, calm yourself down and listen carefully.

units.source_text: 恐高症、尖物恐惧症、麻药中毒、歇斯底里、杀人狂、梅毒、白痴……

en.t: Acrophobia, fear of sharp objects, drug poisoning, hysteria, homicidal mania, syphilis, idiocy...

units.source_text: 各百分之一，合计起来百分之二十……

en.t: One percent each, adding up to twenty percent...

units.source_text: 照这个势头，往后要是再列举出八十个异常的例子……

en.t: At this rate, if we go on and list another eighty abnormal cases...
Needless to say, we certainly could...

units.source_text: 甚至能够统计证明，人类百分之百的不正常。）

en.t: We could even prove statistically that one hundred percent of humanity is abnormal.)
